svg.title: Smokejumper v1 layered component architecture
svg.desc: Target v1 component view showing channels, deterministic ingestion and actions, LangGraph intelligence, knowledge, governed MCP tools, observability, and the three-service runtime foundation. Current implementation status remains normative in SPEC.md.
svg.text: Smokejumper — agentic SRE incident responder
Layered component view · v1 design (updated 2026-07-26) · an alert lands, Smokejumper parachutes in, investigates in parallel, reports back with receipts

svg.text: TOOL BACKENDS — lab compose profile, local environment only
Prometheus → metric query · Loki → log search · faultbox → injected faults with known ground truth, so a Conclusion can be scored automatically
RUNTIME FOUNDATION
Three services: app · one Postgres 16 + pgvector · Redis. FastAPI · LangGraph + Postgres checkpointer · in-process FastMCP · model-agnostic LLM provider
HOW IT WORKS — one incident, end to end

g.text: 1 · Current: the Receiver verifies the source, normalizes to AgentEvent, dedupes, and commits a Postgres outbox row.
Target: it also coalesces storms. No model has run yet.
2 · The outbox dispatches to Redis Streams at least once. Current: one consumer group; target: Governor
concurrency, stale-pending reclaim, and the storm brake.
3 · The supervisor wakes and retrieves memory — similar past incidents and matching runbooks — then
plans which specialists can answer the question the alert is really asking.
4 · Specialists run in parallel, each stateless and budgeted, calling read-tier tools through the one MCP gateway.
A privileged call suspends the entire run until a human approves it in Slack with a single-use token.
5 · Findings aggregate into exactly one Conclusion (B6) with confidence and evidence references. Nothing
downstream of this contract is allowed to call a model.
6 · Current Actions writes one run-idempotent fixture ticket; target adds Linear and Slack receipts. The recorder
holds the trace as JSONL, and replay re-runs it from recorded model and tool outputs.

svg.text: Dashed = black-box port or external (v1 ships stubs) · Amber = human-approval-gated · Violet = knowledge & memory · Teal = core, deterministic edges · Blue = platform services
Determinism boundaries: no model runs before B2 or after B6 · Governance invariant: every tool call, including knowledge federation, crosses the one MCP gateway
Post-v1, so absent here: the knowledge graph and ≤2-hop expansion, and the Distiller · Versioned boundary contracts B1–B11 · event-flow detail in smokejumper-architecture.mmd
